shape: 3-portal large arena (S+W+E gates with east clique, north corridor, west arm)
description: Three-portal arena split into three zones connected by a north corridor. The EAST cluster (around ywzng8 + t6k7dx + w6dwxc + bufut9 + i2vhnh) is densely interconnected and contains spawn_south + spawn_east. The WEST arm (bjwh3s + 7n2y6m + 66vt1g + 7jlbo3) connects spawn_west through a vertical chain. The NORTH CORRIDOR (7iwjyj + db3sm6) bridges east and west clusters along Z=-12.

portals.south: spawn_south at (11.88, 23.09) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, east column
portals.west: spawn_west at (-22.81, 15.48) — gate on the west (low-X) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (22.95, -10.97) — gate on the east (high-X) side

anchors.description: south entry hub — joins south_gate (matches bufut9)
north corridor east step — bridge anchor (matches 7iwjyj)

traversalNotes: Direct south ↔ east: spawn_south → south_inner → east_s → east_mid → east_inner → spawn_east. 5 hops within the east cluster.
Direct west ↔ east: spawn_west → west_inner → west_n → west_c → north_corr_w → north_corr_e → east_inner → spawn_east. 7 hops via the north corridor bridge.
Direct west ↔ south: spawn_west → west_inner → west_n → west_c → north_corr_w → north_corr_e → east_mid → east_s → south_inner → spawn_south. 9 hops.
NORTH CORRIDOR (north_corr_e + north_corr_w along Z=-12) is the only bridge between east and west clusters — don't emit cross-cluster shortcuts.
Two single-degree pockets (south_pocket, west_sb) hang off east_inner / west_inner for corner objectives.
